classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Single SVG dependency-arrow overlay (`Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer`) for `Neo.gantt.Container`.
 * @description Renders directed task dependencies (`FS`, `SS`, `FF`, `SF`) inside a single `<svg>` element layered over
 * the center timeline track. Only dependencies whose source and target tasks are currently expanded in `taskStore`
 * and whose horizontal span intersects `[scrollLeft - bufferPx, scrollLeft + viewportWidth + bufferPx]` are projected
 * into `<path class="neo-gantt-dependency-arrow">` descriptors.
 *
 * The layer replaces the visible arrows and their marker definitions together as one SVG fragment.
 * It escapes record-derived attributes and skips the DOM update when the fragment and its bounds are unchanged.
 * @class Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer
 * @extends Neo.component.Base
 * @see Neo.gantt.Container
 * @see Neo.gantt.DependencyStore
 */
classData.description:
Renders directed task dependencies (FS, SS, FF, SF) inside a single <svg> element layered over the center timeline track. Only dependencies whose source and target tasks are currently expanded in taskStore and whose horizontal span intersects [scrollLeft - bufferPx, scrollLeft + viewportWidth + bufferPx] are projected into <path class="neo-gantt-dependency-arrow"> descriptors.

The layer replaces the visible arrows and their marker definitions together as one SVG fragment. It escapes record-derived attributes and skips the DOM update when the fragment and its bounds are unchanged.
classData.name: DependencyLayer
